title: Introducing Connected Enterprise: Helping enterprise users access Adobe products and services more seamlessly
summary: Connected Enterprise is changing how enterprise users access Adobe products and services. Here’s what Adobe Express add-on and desktop plugin developers need to know about user IDs and the transition.
